clips.title: The story
paras: At the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, word returns that Daphne Stilwell is safe. After defending her Westfall homestead from bandits, an aspiring paladin reports to Duthorian Rall, completing the Church of the Holy Light's trials of valor. The Church's charge is to shield the innocent without thought for oneself.

Daphne Stilwell's homestead in Westfall is safe after an initiate of the Church of the Holy Light defended it from bandits. Back at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, the aspiring paladin reports her safety to Duthorian Rall. The defense shows the courage and conviction expected of one who stands between danger and the defenseless.

Daphne's husband, Jordan Stilwell, is in Ironforge, where he lends his renowned craftsmanship to the Alliance. With Daphne safe and the homestead guarded, Duthorian Rall prepares to send word north to Jordan. Reassured that his family is protected, the artisan can focus on his work. Their distant homes are bound by the aid the Alliance gives across its lands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.
He'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.
Oh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, we meet again, friend, and you are in high spirits, I see.
The Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.
Daphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.
For your valor, you will be rewarded.
